info.title: BallotData API
info.summary: U.S. ballots, endorsers and endorsements, and a live stream of endorsement changes.
info.description:
Ballot races (elections, contests and their choices), endorsers and endorsements across the U.S., who holds office now, and a stream of endorsement changes.

Everything is JSON over HTTPS. Send your API key on every request as `Authorization: Bearer ebk_…`. Lists are paged: `{ "data": [...], "next_cursor": "…" }`; pass `cursor` for the next page. Errors are `{ "error": { "code", "message", "request_id" } }`.

Address and geography lookups (the ballot at an address, districts and boundaries, representatives by location) have been retired: choose races by state, election or contest.

tags.name: Elections
tags.description: States, elections and coverage: what there is to ask about.

tags.name: Contests
tags.description: The races on a ballot and their choices: candidates, or Yes/No for a measure. Contests carry their voting rules: vote for one, vote for N (votes_allowed), ranked choice (ranks_allowed), or yes/no.

tags.name: Endorsers
tags.description: Who endorses: unions, newspapers, parties, clubs, advocacy groups and officials, by category and home state.

tags.name: Endorsements
tags.description: Who each endorser backs in each race.

tags.name: Officeholders
tags.description: Who holds each seat now, from Open States.

tags.name: Stream
tags.description: Every endorsement added, changed or removed, as Server-Sent Events or by polling. Needs the stream:read scope and a plan that includes the stream.

tags.name: Subscriptions
tags.description: Saved filters for the stream and events. Reading needs stream:read; changing needs subscriptions:write.

  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BALLOTDATA_API_KEY"

x-codeSamples.label: JavaScript
Python
x-codeSamples.source:
import os
import requests

res = requests.get(
    "https://api.ballotdata.net/v1/states",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['BALLOTDATA_API_KEY']}"},
)
res.raise_for_status()
data = res.json()["data"]

get.description: Elections, with their voting rules in details (all-mail, ranked choice, fusion, runoff dates) and how many contests and endorsements each has. Use an election’s slug to ask for its contests or endorsements.

parameters.name: types

parameters.name: upcoming
parameters.description: Only elections from yesterday on.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Elections on or after this date.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Elections on or before this date.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: es for Spanish ballot text (titles, choices, measure text, statements) where the state publishes it; English otherwise. Names are never translated.

parameters.name: cursor

get.description:
Every endorsement change matching a subscription or inline filter, as Server-Sent Events, within seconds of it happening. Events: ready (first, with the subscription name), endorsement (an Event), checkpoint (moves your position past changes your filter skipped), reconnect (we end connections after an hour), and error (cursor_expired). A comment line arrives every 20 seconds.

Each event id is a cursor: reconnect with Last-Event-ID (EventSource does this itself) or ?cursor= to continue. Opening a stream counts as one request; your plan sets how many you can hold open.

parameters.name: subscription
parameters.description: A saved subscription’s id or name, instead of filter parameters.

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: Endorser category slugs (GET /v1/endorser-categories). Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: endorsers
parameters.description: Endorser slugs. Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: endorser_states

parameters.name: states
parameters.description: States the contests are voted in (USPS codes). Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: elections

import json
import os
import requests

with requests.get(
    "https://api.ballotdata.net/v1/stream",
    params={"subscription": "CA labor"},
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['BALLOTDATA_API_KEY']}"},
    stream=True,
) as res:
    res.raise_for_status()
    event = None
    for line in res.iter_lines(decode_unicode=True):
        if line.startswith("event: "):
            event = line[7:]
        elif line.startswith("data: ") and event == "endorsement":
            print(json.loads(line[6:]))
